nodes.title: Поиск всех животных на фото
widgets_values: Find every animal in this image: cats, dogs, horses, rabbits, birds and any other pets. Output only JSON, a list with one entry per animal, each entry with "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2] around the whole animal and "label"

nodes.title: Описание животного по фото (автоматически)
widgets_values: Describe the animal in this photo for an artist who will paint its portrait. Write one English noun phrase of at most 70 words that covers only its permanent appearance: species, whether it is a puppy, kitten or adult, the breed only if it is unmistakable (for cats almost never: do not say Siamese, Ragdoll, Persian or similar), coat length and texture, the exact coat colors and where they are described in plain color words (say whether the face is light or dark, and do not use pattern names such as point, seal or lynx), distinctive markings and on which side of the face they are (patches, blaze, spots, stripes, freckles on the nose, dark fur on the muzzle), the exact color of the nose including any dark freckles or spots on it, and the eye color (one color for both eyes; mention two different colors only if the difference is obvious). Do not mention the ears at all, nor pose, background, people, toys, glasses, clothes or lighting. If there are several animals, pick the largest one and describe only that single animal; never mix features of different animals and never mention the others. Answer with the phrase only.

nodes.title: Цвет фона: палитра из 24 пастельных тонов
Промпт: начало
widgets_values: Paint a new portrait of the exact same animal as in the reference image. The animal:

nodes.title: Промпт: до цвета фона
widgets_values: Keep its species, breed, anatomy, ear shape, coat colors, fur pattern, markings, eye color and facial features exactly as in the reference image. Portrait composition: only the head and the upper chest, the animal faces the viewer frontally and looks directly into the camera with direct eye contact, symmetrical calm pose, perfectly centered horizontally, the muzzle and eyes are the focal point. Empty background above the ears. The chest fills the bottom of the picture and continues past the bottom edge, cropped by the frame, with no fade-out and no vignette at the bottom; the body does not touch the left and right edges. Background: a perfectly flat, smooth, uniform solid

nodes.title: Промпт: после цвета фона (стиль)
widgets_values: pastel color, no texture, no gradient, no objects, no floor, no shadow. Style: expressive hand-painted pet portrait in oil and gouache, at the intersection of a realistic portrait, decorative painting and minimalist design. Clearly visible confident brushstrokes: the fur is built from distinct painterly strokes that follow the direction of the hair, looser and broader on the body, finer on the face; soft airy tonal transitions between them. The eyes and nose are painted with crisp detail. At the outline the fur ends in loose painted wisps over the plain background, with no hard cut-out edge. Harmonious palette, soft diffused frontal lighting without harsh shadows. It must look painted by hand with a brush: not a photograph, no vector art, no flat cel shading, no outlines. No text, no letters, no signature, no frame.
